data.summary: Results-driven Lead Business Analyst and Product Owner with 11+ years of experience transforming business objectives into scalable digital solutions across Banking (UK Cards & Payments – Issuing), US Healthcare, Supply Chain and various other domains. Proven expertise in product roadmapping, backlog prioritisation, and cross-functional stakeholder collaboration. Adept at business process re-engineering and aligning sprint goals with business strategy to deliver scalable and measurable outcomes.

responsibilities: Owned product discovery, roadmap & scope definition while leading business analysis for the migration of European customers to a new regulated entity
Impact Assessment: Led impact assessments across multiple workstreams within the issuing business of the entity to understand the impact of migration & cross-workstream dependency mapping.
Workshop Facilitation: Facilitated stakeholder workshops to establish product scope, align strategic priorities, & secure stakeholder buy-in.
External Stakeholder Collaboration: Partnered with major card payment schemes to coordinate licensing requirements, enabling seamless transition for the new entity.
Backlog Management: Reduced requirement ambiguity by ~30–40% through structured workshops, backlog refinement, prioritised user stories and clearly defined acceptance criteria.
Spearheaded end-to-end execution of automated refund process for CHAPS & SWIFT payment methods, achieving a ~60–70% reduction in manual effort.
Workflow Optimisation: Improved processing throughput by 40–50% and minimised operational errors through defined business rules, automated validation controls and workflow optimisation.

Cards & Payments / Corporate Cards: Worked hands-on on UK and European Cards & Payments programmes, with strong exposure to Corporate Card issuing, card lifecycle, payment processing and related business processes for Barclays.

Visa/Mastercard Scheme & Regulatory Changes: Worked with card payment schemes including Visa/Mastercard on scheme requirements, regulatory changes and implementation activities, assessing business and system impact across the card-issuing environment.

Regulatory Change & Implementation: Analysed regulatory and scheme requirements and translated them into business requirements, process changes and system enhancements, supporting implementation across UK and European markets.

AML & Compliance: Worked hands-on with AML and regulatory compliance requirements within banking/card programmes, collaborating with business, compliance and technology stakeholders to ensure requirements were incorporated into the solution.

Risk & Control Assessment: Performed risk and impact assessments for regulatory and business changes, identifying process/control gaps, assessing downstream impacts and defining remediation requirements.

Regulatory Control Framework: Supported the definition and implementation of regulatory controls across card/payment processes, ensuring business rules, system workflows and operational processes remained aligned with applicable regulatory requirements.

UAT & Compliance Validation: Led/coordinated SIT/UAT, defect management, business validation and sign-off for regulatory and card-payment changes, ensuring implemented requirements met business, compliance and scheme expectations.

Regulatory Traceability: Maintained requirement traceability from regulatory/scheme requirements through functional requirements, development, testing and UAT sign-off, ensuring complete implementation coverage.

UK & Europe Regulatory Rollout: Supported country/market-specific implementation of regulatory and card-payment changes across UK and European markets, coordinating dependencies across business, technology, compliance and testing teams.
Delivery Governance: Translated business goals into actionable epics, wireframes, and acceptance criteria (DoD/DoR), preventing scope creep and reducing development rework.

Team Alignment: Collaborated with Solution Architects to validate design against business requirements and guided Scrum squads during sprint delivery to align technical implementation with roadmap goals.
Owned the EHR system enhancement and feature delivery for lab modules and seamless HL7 integrations
Managed end-to-end backlog grooming and sprint planning, establishing clear Definition of Ready (DoR) standards
Led User Acceptance Testing (UAT) sign-offs & defect triage to ensure high product quality
Worked as a BA on various enterprise application projects, understanding & translating business needs into clear & actionable requirements.
Created user stories, wireframes, and process flows.
Supported pre-sales activities such as use case feasibility analysis, solutioning & WBS.
Contributed to product ideation & implementation strategies, particularly in IoT; conducted market research & competitive analysis for informed decision-making.
